purpose: Clean native desktop-default-equivalent development baseline and matched generation-strategy experiment; not a representative product quality gate.

settings.strategy_application: Each scheduled treatment overrides only generation.strategy; exact requests are retained in every capture. Treatments/trials/cases are jointly shuffled; each gets a separate empty/reuse cache.

integrity.independent_output_checks: Every successful capture checked by xtask verify (separate letter/constraint verifier) during collection.

existing_human_label_coverage.counting: Display positions across two repeated trials; not independent bags or new judgments.
Display positions across two repeated trials; not independent bags or new judgments.

decision.promotion: Retain prefix. Both strategies recover intended references on 12/50 exposed bags per trial. Diverse adds one existing known-useful bag (multigrams-02), nearly doubles median cold latency and consistently times out on small_birds. This is a tradeoff on development evidence, not a demonstrated general-quality win.
decision.next_evidence: The protocol’s broader independent bag/source-family collection and contextual judgments remain outstanding. No experimental corpus/model/search default was installed.

limitations: 50 development-exposed bags are not 50 independent source families or untouched holdout puzzles.
Two trials and two cache states are repeated observations of each bag, not independent quality samples.
Whole CLI-process wall time includes source intake and JSON transport; it does not measure WebView rendering or desktop IPC latency.
Resident memory is sampled per CLI process tree at 20 ms intervals; it is not a guaranteed peak or whole installed-application footprint.
OS filesystem cache and other workstation activity are uncontrolled; no causal before/after optimization speedup is claimed.
Existing permissive owner labels are matched to exact rendering/inventory; uncertain, conflicted and unjudged outputs remain unresolved.
No new labels were created, no experimental corpus/model was installed, and an unjudged output is not classified as useless.
Immutable managed-pack activation, broader parsed-corpus reuse and large review-list paging remain measured follow-up opportunities.
